selection_reason: V40 makes a rig-consistent 1.5% arm-chain length extension from V36: upper/lower arm bones and all wrist descendants move with the correspondingly skin-weighted surface, including every relative key. It improves side and back, raises mean/minimum slightly; front changes -0.02071. Actual squat/push-up, structural and strict driver QA pass. V39 2.5% gives a higher side but worse minimum; V41 1% loses V40 mean/minimum. Not99 or final animation approval.
